notes.title: Combat Update now available!
notes.notes:
Hey Foragers!

It's finally time! [b]The Combat Update is upon us![/b]

This update has been the most ambitious undertaking we have tackled ever since the game released! The goal was to add more challenging encounters, to ease out the power curve and to improve the gameplay length.

Remember, I want to keep working on this game for years to come so let me know what would you like to see in the future!

Check out the official new trailer!

[previewyoutube=33nSGFwjNWY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]New Content and Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Biome/Dungeon: The Void.[/b]
New procedural endless world players can travel to late in the game. You must defeat all enemies before the time runs out, or you will be teleported out! Defeating all the enemies in time will allow you to continue to the next level of the Void. Each time you progress, enemies will become stronger and more diverse, but your rewards will increase as well!

[*] [b]New Game Mode: Hard Mode.[/b]
Hard Mode is available directly from the main menu when creating new savefiles, and it allows you to play Forager in a MUCH more difficult setting. All enemies are stronger and will attack your base, new enemies will also appear at night, and resource costs are increased!

[*] [b]New Gear and Item Tiers: Void and Cosmic.[/b]
Two new and powerful tiers of gear that offer higher stats and new abilities, crafted from materials gained from content added in this update.

[*] [b]Improved Combat Difficulty.[/b]
All enemies have increased stats, and some of them have improved AI and new combat moves! ALL Bossfights are also more difficult now!

[*] [b]New Enemies and Bosses.[/b]
Face off against powerful new foes!

[*] [b]Pets.[/b]
Unlock your own personal pet through the new Pet skill in the Foraging branch!

[*] [b]Starfalls.[/b]
Legends say during the darkest nights, stars will randomly fall from the sky and Foragers everywhere are free to mine them for goodies!

[*] [b]Railroads.[/b]
Go deep into the Industry branch of skills to unlock Railroads and Locomotives! These contraptions will allow you to move quickly through your giant base!

[*] [b]Boss-Summoning Sigils.[/b]
Fight new powerful late-game bosses by summoning them on your base! You will be able to fully create and customize an arena to give you an advantage over them!

[*] [b]New Secret NPC.[/b]
There is a new secret trader NPC that only spawns at night and will sell rare items!

[*] [b]Skill Grid Rework.[/b]
A lot of the boring/useless skills have been reworked or removed, and new ones have been added!

[*] [b]Game Balance/Pacing Rework.[/b]
Improved pacing and difficulty! Finally! Players won't be able to unlock overpowered skills and gear TOO early anymore, making the pacing smoother and gameplay longer!

[*] [b]New Inventory Menu.[/b]
New design and new features! Sort items manually, Send items to Vaults automatically, Add/Remove items from your Toolbar and full item descriptions!

[*] [b]New Crafting Menu.[/b]
New design and new features! Infinite crafting, Pinned recipes and full item descriptions!

[*] [b]Vault Locking.[/b]
You are now able to lock slots on Vaults to make sure only the specified item goes in it!

[*] [b]100 New Items![/b]

[*] [b]A TON of Bugfixes![/b]
[/list]


Let me know what you think of this update and what other updates we should make in the future!

Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Forager: Combat Update is releasing next week!

Hey Foragers!

[b]The full update will be completely free for everyone[/b], and will release next week along with a [b]discount on the game![/b] And here are some of the main features that it will bring:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/995eec025ec73f3f988fb46cbe9187dce4e911c8.png[/img]

New procedural endless world players can travel to late in the game. You must defeat all enemies before the time runs out, or you will be teleported out! Defeating all the enemies in time will allow you to continue to the next level of the Void. Each time you progress, enemies will become stronger and more diverse, but your rewards will increase as well!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/cde1777361a510ec9e99a84752bb5ab0a3738643.png[/img]

Hard Mode is available directly from the main menu when creating new savefiles, and it allows you to play Forager in a MUCH more difficult setting. All enemies are stronger and will attack your base, new enemies will also appear at night, and resource costs are increased! There are also some new powerful bosses to optionally summon and fight in all game modes!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/ba8b6abea7c0e5825e49728db107b29432695607.png[/img]

100 new items with a variety of uses and crafting recipes! Including two new and powerful tiers of gear that offer higher stats and new abilities!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32334585/01e23aea44e4d01817649db0deff6d4698b33b82.gif[/img]
[h1]New Inventory, Crafting and Build menus![/h1]

New design and new features! Pin recipes, infinite crafting option, sort items manually, send items to Vaults automatically, add/remove items from your Toolbar and full item and structure descriptions!


[b]And many things more![/b]
[list]
[*] 15 new Feats with 15 new cosmetic items
[*] Starfalls
[*] Pets
[*] Railroads
[*] Secret Trader NPC
[*] Boss-summoning sigils
[*] Vault locking
[*] Balance and pacing changes
[*] Reworked Skill Grid
[*] And hundreds of bugfixes!

[b]Again, the update will release next week on Tuesday 15th![/b]

Thanks to everyone that helped us playtest, reported bugs and gave us feedback on content and features!

[url=discord.gg/HopFrog][h1]If you want to be involved in our future update closed beta testing sessions, join our Discord server![/h1][/url]

Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Free Appreciation Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/f58e2fbe55a1297afe192a016c0b974275ac11fa.png[/img]

It's time, fellow Foragers!

This free update is a thank you to all of you! It is an ambitious amount to add in only a month, but we wanted to show our gratitude to all of you for the incredible level of support you have all shown since our release. We hope you enjoy! 

[b]As an additional thank you, Forager is for the first time on sale! New players can now get it at 15% off until Monday 10th! Tell your friends![/b]

Special thanks to our awesome beta-testers that made sure the update was stable for all PC players alike! ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/151ab7189e7b86bda390b540d90aa5d6fe686e58.png[/img]

[h1]Features / Quality of Life[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]New Game Modes[/b] [i](Single Island Challenge in which you need to get all Tools to win and Speedrun Mode in which you need to get all Feats to win, with more to come in future updates!)[/i]

[*] New [b]Carpentry Station[/b] building with [b]10 new decorative items![/b]

[*] New [b]Weather system[/b] with new visual effects. In the near future this will also contain gameplay modifiers! ([i]There will soon be an option to turn this off for people having issues with old PCs[/i])

[*] Improved [b]Sunrise/Sunsets[/b]

[*] A TON of new [b]ingame options[/b]!

[*] Some new [i]secret[/i] options...

[*] [b]Improves crash-proof saving.[/b] Losing savefiles to random crashes or computer shutdowns should be much rarer now!

[*] Removes buffs from shrines if they cannot be used / assist the player

[*] Disables cosmetic items being automatically equipped visually

[*] Nerfs Fairy Aura healing effects

[*] Increases [b]enemy and boss max HP[/b]

[*] Adds a button to [b]auto-sort the inventory[/b]

[*] Updates [b]in-game roadmap[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/6e795244ef2c55c73ed18590cd9044fb562fe043.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes / Stability[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue where the “Tool Collector” feat would misfire
[*] Removes a crash related to using a controller on upgraded vaults
[*] Prevents an issue where opening a treasure chest before skill requirements are met can prevent players from 100% completing the game
[*] Stops the bow from firing if a different tool is selected
[*] Allows for enemy’s coin drops to be influenced by amulets and lighthouses
[*] Ensures that steam achievements are unlocked when feats are completed
[*] Fixes various localization issues / typos
[*] Optimizes placing buildings late game (fixing an issue where building new structures late game would temporarily freeze the game)
[*] Fixes an issue where sorting your inventory made items vanish (try sorting your inventory again now, the items should reappear) 
[*] Old saves now have carpentry station unlocked
[*] Fixes a crash when opening vaults
[*] Fixes a bug where starting in Classic mode unlocks the Addicted feat
[*] Removes the rain sound from stacking multiple times
[*] Stops beds and other new items from being used in the inventory
[*] Resolves an issue where destroying a gate doesn't return the item
[*] Ensures that roads are removed from the inventory when using them
[*] Restores the 3rd row for vaults
[*] Fixes issues with new items in the market
[*] Stops torchbugs from instantly despawning
[*] Shrinks the hitbox on the Carpentry Station to better represent its size
[*] Prevents the mouse from falling behind certain menus
[*] Stops you from placing roads on tiles that already have roads
[*] Roads can no longer be placed on bridges
[*] Fixes an issue where placing a fence on top of yourself messes up neighbor fences
[*] New items can no longer be placed on water
[*] Fixes an issue where the flower pot is invisible when dropped on the ground
[*] Untoggles single click attacks when swapping items
[*] Adds audio to hitting beds
[*] Makes lights glow properly during the sunrise
[*] Corrects the timing of music
[*] You can't destroy tiles that are occupied by a familiar / drone
[*] Changing some settings with a controller can crash the game
[*] Controller does not work on the gamemode selection menu
[*] Destroying land underneath roads does not destroy the road
[*] You can get yourself stuck by buying an island on top of you
[*] Using excavator on shrines can put digging spots on top of roads
[*] Placing a fence can crash the game when you have too many fences
[*] Having structure costs split between vault and inventory will only consume items from the inventory 
[*] Placing the mouse between two buttons in the rebind screen generates noise
[*] The new artifact screen is slightly rotated
[*] You can get stuck sleeping
[*] Skeletons and demons don't spawn in the single island challenge 
[*] Drinking the mandragora potion can make structures disappear
[*] Carpentry table isn't listed in skill description
[*] Opening the skills menu while in bed will bug the player position
[*] Single Island Challenge can't be completed
[*] Secret rooms feat won't trigger
[*] Camera does not zoom out in buy / build mode
[*] You can exploit death to replenish energy
[*] You can revert a sacrifice by re-entering your save
[*] Inconsistencies while saving / reverting altar usage in skull maze (after exiting the game)
[*] Can't save the options of a save file while in dungeons
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/5b0f298d262d65ddfa54f33c26070d39f6917ef1.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy all the new stuff! It was a ton of fun to make, and we have plans to keep working on this game for as long as you want us to!

Thank you for your support and happy foraging!

notes.title: Forager Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey Foragers!

Wow! I have been so incredibly overwhelmed with the support! Thank you so much for playing Forager and for providing feedback, thanks to your great ideas and suggestions I managed to rework the update roadmap for future Forager content.

The main points raised are as follows:

[list]
[*] Accessibility options are nice but we need to do more/better and secret options should be moved to the ingame config menus

[*] Core gameplay is addictive but it ends too soon (~20 hours and then nothing to do anymore)

[*] The game's pacing feels wrong (Automation and Droids can make things TOO easy, some Gear items are too cheap while others are too expensive, there is idle downtime way too often while you wait for things to craft or spawn, etc)

[*] Combat is not challenging/rewarding

[*] Some quality of life changes are needed (inventory sorting, better save backups, removal of sound stacking for Mining Rods, etc)
[/list]

Our updates from now on will focus on increasing gameplay length and adding replayability! Check it out:


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/8e02e933a2278e6c85be4ef91e7d84772cdd731c.jpg[/img]


I would like to clarify some extra things that are often asked:
[list]
[*] The Mac version of the game should be coming [i]soon[/i]. I don't have a time estimate for this!

[*] The console versions of the game (PS4 and Nintendo Switch) still have no date announcements. I will let you know as soon as I know more!
[/list]


[url=discord.gg/HopFrog]Join the community on Discord if you want to help me make this game awesome![/url]

[url=https://mailchi.mp/hopfrogsa.com/forager]Or subscribe to our newsletter if you just want to be notified when these updates go live![/url]


Thank you so much for your support and Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Forager v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Foragers!

We are working on hard on 1.1.0, but in the meantime, we have made a quick patch for anyone who is blocked from playing due to a corrupt save file.

1.1.0 will introduce a new system for writing files that will hopefully mitigate save file corruption, even in the event of a PC shutdown. Thank you so much to those who suggested the various system to address this issue!


[h1]Bug Fixes/ Stability[/h1]
[list]
[*] If a save file is corrupted, the game will now automatically load in a backup, allowing you to play on that file if it is not also corrupted!

[*] Corrupted save files will now only display an error if you click on them (which means you can still start the game and play different save files)

[*] Corrupted save files will no longer end the game, but will instead take you back to the main menu
[/list]



[b]More gameplay content is coming soon![/b]


Thank you for your patience and support, and Happy Foraging! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Forager v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/47ddf9cd5c2ed6297db1b5e597824c5e7536e05b.jpg[/img]

[h1]General Notes / Reminders[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you have a bug to report, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/751780/discussions/1/]report it on our Steam subforum[/url] or [url=discord.gg/HopFrog]via the !bugreport command in our Discord server.[/url] We are currently receiving too many DM's and emails to possibly answer, and we want to make sure all your issues are addressed! Additionally, please be sure to [url=https://trello.com/b/NkahLQ5c/forager]look on our Trello board[/url] before reporting a bug -- many issues that are reported are already logged there!


[*] For players who are getting stuck in water/objects, we are now testing a new feature which will attempt to free you when loading a save. If you get stuck, simply exit to menu and reload the save!


[*] [b]Our last patch's fix for the rainbow puzzle only pertains to save files that have not already lost mushrooms.[/b] There are a few issues with the rainbow puzzle ([i]most notably how it is inaccessible to colorblind players[/i]), and we are currently discussing how we wish to address this. We hope to update you on this soon!


[*] If your computer shuts down while playing Forager, and your save files no longer open, there is nothing we can do to fix this! A computer shutdown, while the game is saving, will forever corrupt the savefiles ([i]this is why games ask you not to turn off the machine while the game saves, by the way![/i]). [b]If you are having trouble deleting your save data, open the game, delete the saves, then press the "PLAY" button on the main menu.[/b]


[*] The Waterproof feat is obtainable right now, but due to a bug, the feat only checks for completion when you place a landfill, not a bridge. [b]To get around this, just make sure that your final block placed is landfill.[/b] We will look into fixing this in the future, and also making it easier to find your last missing water tiles!


[*] Some users have reported that they are not getting Steam achievements. Most of these users have had the issue resolved by enabling their Steam overlay. We will try to see if there are ways we can work around this! Currently, an achievement will only unlock if Steam gets the request when you first get the achievement, but we will look into having Steam check them all when you load your saves in the future!
[/list]


[h1]Features / Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lowers the maximum resource spawn number slightly more (to prevent resource overcrowding).

[*] Allows the coin counter to distinguish between quadrillions and quintillions (because apparently you guys actually need this, yes, we're impressed!)
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes / Stability[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes various crashes
[*] Fixes a bug where standing by the Jester makes your UI disappear
[*] Stops bridges from popping into the view too late if you're running too fast
[*] Updates corrupt save error messages to be clearer
[*] Adds an anti-softlock system when loading saves
[*] Fixes an issue where chests would spawn in unobtainable places in the museum
[*] Allows bridges to be built on the left side of the map
[*] Fixes most occurrences of collisions not working when the player is off the camera
[/list]



That's it for now!


I will write a post soon gathering some of my thoughts about Forager's reception and what the future of the game looks like. Stay tuned!


Thank you so much for your support and Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Forager Beta 8.1 + Mac version!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/47ddf9cd5c2ed6297db1b5e597824c5e7536e05b.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We have developed a hotfix for Beta 8 that should solve most of the weird new issues you have been finding lately.

First of all, thank you so much for sending in those bug reports! It's been ridiculously useful, seriously! Let's keep them coming!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/439b1f355e9a010a2296819acade91d24dbdce66.gif[/img]


[h1]IMPORTANT THINGS:[/h1]

[b]All savefiles older than Beta 7 are not officially supported anymore.[/b] They may or may not work when you try to load them! If you played Beta 7 or Beta 8 with those savefiles, however, you have nothing to worry about!

Also, we are looking into the bug that causes stuff to just disappear. For now, you can fix this by [b]exiting to the main menu and reloading your savefile.[/b]

And finally, the game's folder in [b]%LOCALAPPDATA%[/b] has been renamed from [i]"Forager_Steam_"[/i] to [i]"Forager"[/i]. [b]If you want to load your old savefiles make sure you go there and rename that folder![/b]

[u][b]Here is a quick way to do it:[/b][/u]
[list] 
[*] Press Windows + R
[*] Type %LOCALAPPDATA% and hit Enter
[*] Find the folder named Forager_Steam_ and rename it to Forager
[/list]


[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Added [b]Mac OS support[/b] (Beta).

[*] The entire game's [b]file sizes have been drastically reduced.[/b]

[*] Some [b]new Extra Content[/b] has been added to the main menu. (Extras button).

[*] [b]Controller selection[/b] changed from collision boxes to raycasting to improve accuracy.

[*] [b]Several balance changes[/b] (Banks work faster, Animals drop more Hide, Most buildings are cheaper).

[*] The game's folder in %LOCALAPPDATA% has been renamed from "Forager_Steam_" to "Forager". This means that if you wish to load your old savefiles into Beta 8.1 you [b]NEED TO GO AND RENAME THAT FOLDER![/b]

[*] [b]Added automatic savefile backups[/b] in case of emergencies. (They will be in the same folder as the normal savefiles).
[/list]


[h1]BUGFIXES:[/h1]
[list] 
[*] Capturing critters with bottles may crash the game or spawn spikes.
[*] Loading incompatible savefiles would crash the game without displaying a warning message.
[*] Resources may spawn on top of each other.
[*] Entities may occasionally walk through collisions and buildings.
[*] The puzzle in the Ancient Galaxy was not working (receptors were not being electrified by the cubes).
[*] Sprinklers were not working.
[*] Rainbow puzzle may be solved multiple times.
[*] Game credit's had a weird text gap.
[*] Fixed Inscription Table icon on the build menu.
[*] Venom bolts from Mandragora potion could poison and destroy spikes.
[*] Pressing E fast enough on animals would cause them to drop several resources at once.
[*] Main menu could randomly crash.
[*] Gem puzzle in the Graveyard wasn't working correctly.
[*] Bridges wouldn't auto-heal like the rest of the buildings.
[*] Markets were not being restocked correctly.
[*] Chests may randomly decided they didn't need to obey the laws of physics.
[*] Collecting Gear items could occasionally crash the game.
[*] Resources could spawn outside of the world bounds.
[*] Skeletons would play their spawn sounds every time the main screen was loaded.
[*] Droids could randomly have the player's sprite.
[/list]


[h1]DOWNLOAD:[/h1]

[url=https://hopfrog.itch.io/forager-beta-8]If you own Beta 6 or higher, click here! [/url]

[url=https://hopfrog.itch.io/forager-beta-8/patreon-access]If you don't know which Beta you own, but are a Patreon supporter, click here! [/url]

[url=https://hopfrog.itch.io/forager]If you don't yet have access to the closed Beta but want to play the game, click here! [/url]



Happy Foraging!

notes.title: Development Update + Instagram stuff
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, great news today!

[b]Beta 8 is almost ready to be play-tested and will go live this Friday (February 15th).[/b]

There have been a lot of changes to the game's code, which will maximize performance even in the late game for all computers and devices. I am talking constant 60-fps! Time to get some mega-bases going!

This of course means there probably will be new bugs we haven't caught, so please let me know if you see or find anything weird. Lazyeye has implemented a fancy new system that lets you send me bug reports from inside the game itself! I will go on more detail about this on Friday.

Anyway! I wanted to show you a sneak peek of what's coming this weekend. Mainly the [b]new and improved Menu System![/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/5770ea72d19cf36a136056d3631189981cb1a0c9.gif[/img]


What I love about this new design are all the exciting new things we can do with it. You will notice we have a few new buttons: [b]Extras[/b], [b]Roadmap [/b]and [b]Community[/b].

I will also be featuring a fan art from the community every week in the main menu. [url=https://twitter.com/_HopFrog]I have been doing this on my social media channels for a bit,[/url] but now the incredible artists of the Forager community will be featured inside the game itself too!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/6eb7645aa2b432265c49e330b56a36f3fc79882a.gif[/img]


The [b]Extras [/b]submenu is my personal favorite! We have added hours of new content to the game, that will be unlocked directly from the main menu by completing Feats during your playthroughs (achievements).
Some of them will be ingame content, some will be outside the game, and some will be stuff like the official Forager Comic Book, that will now be viewable directly from this menu!

[u][b]More secret extras will be coming in the future, even after release![/b][/u]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/c6f54d571cadd727efd08e15b65456e6bded1c36.gif[/img]


The [b]Roadmap [/b]submenu will show what content updates are coming to the game after release!

[u]Reminder: [b][url=https://www.patreon.com/hopfrog]ALL content updates will be FREE FOR EVERYONE thanks to the generous support of our hundreds of patrons![/url][/b][/u]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/faa8924c0adcf76b2c03884b70294b4b0ddcd507.gif[/img]


That's pretty much it for now! I know I have been quiet lately as we were getting ready to add the final details to the game.

During my birthday last week, I promised myself this year of my life I am going to be much more active with the community. Forager has turned into such an awesome project thanks to all of you giving me feedback and telling me what works and what doesn't. Thousands of gamers are WAY smarter than just one dev, so [b]we need to keep this going and make the best game that we can together![/b]

I will be posting content updates and devlogs more often, [url=https://www.instagram.com/_hopfrog_/]and also I have started an Instagram page to post behind the scenes secrets and goodies.[/url] 
Feel free to follow me there if you are curious what it looks like to make video games for a living!


I am really looking forward to people trying Beta 8 this Friday! It's gonna be awesome!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32334585/3daa7a7ac73077db67be0ad4d22f114579a6dbcb.gif[/img]


Happy Foraging!
